gloss: to drizzle in a circular motion; to pour around

definitions.gloss: to drizzle in a circular motion; to pour around
definitions.explanation: To pour a liquid (oil, sauce, dressing) over food while moving the container in a circle so the liquid covers the surface evenly. Common cooking instruction.

examples.japanese: ごま{油|あぶら}を{回|まわ}しかける。
examples.english: Drizzle sesame oil around in a circle.

examples.japanese: {最後|さいご}にしょうゆを{回|まわ}しかけて{火|ひ}を{止|と}める。
examples.english: At the end, drizzle soy sauce around and turn off the heat.

examples.japanese: {溶|と}き{卵|たまご}をフライパンの{中央|ちゅうおう}から{外側|そとがわ}に{向|む}けて{回|まわ}しかける。
examples.english: Pour the beaten egg in a circular motion from the center of the pan toward the outside.

notes:
Compound of {回|まわ}す (to turn) + かける (to pour over). Almost exclusively a cooking term, found in recipes. Conveys both the action of pouring and the circular motion that distributes the liquid evenly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ごま{油|あぶら}を{回|まわ}しかける: to drizzle sesame oil
- しょうゆを{回|まわ}しかける: to drizzle soy sauce
- {溶|と}き{卵|たまご}を{回|まわ}しかける: to pour beaten egg in a circle
- ドレッシングを{回|まわ}しかける: to drizzle dressing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- かける: to pour over — general; no implication of circular motion
- {注|そそ}ぐ: to pour — into a container, not over food
